name: Bootstrap
purpose: Verify the Core-owned execution foundation before any AI-assisted work begins.
completion_criteria: The active vNext Intent, fixed Plan, Catalog, Graph, Effective Policy, Workspace, selected Repository roots, and Core recording paths have passed deterministic verification.
A canonical Bootstrap Receipt is persisted with a project-relative source of truth and SHA-256 reference.
Core records ST-00 completion and advances only through the fixed ST-00 to ST-01 Graph edge.
stop_conditions: The active Intent is missing, ambiguous, or not initialized for vNext.
State, Plan, Catalog, Graph, or Effective Policy is missing, malformed, tampered, or inconsistent.
The active Space or a selected Repository root is missing, unsafe, or unreadable.
Core cannot acquire the Workspace lock or persist canonical Receipt, Audit, and State records.
